title: "Schedule"

Classes normally meet Tuesdays and Thursdays at 11:25 AM in **PH 109**.

Completed lecture topics through September 15 have been checked against the
Panopto recordings. Future topics are provisional and will be updated as
assignments, quizzes, holidays, and examination details are finalized.
